scope: Read-only inspection; proposed support facts, no package/Brain changes or attestation weights changed. Inherited means exact citation URL already present; other inspected pages are leads even if same publisher.
method: Inventory inline plus supplemental sources; group URL to avoid repeated page reads; inspect every target sense separately.
Date is optional; earliest period only where source explicitly gives the selected sense/phrase period. Witness dates are labelled. No global first-use assertions.
No source support propagated through headword similarity, source title, shared publisher or grammatical/semantic extensions.
Term/meaning/Australian-use support can establish evidence, not automatic reads_as or commonness. General dictionary sense without Australian label does not prove Australian usage.
Repository target snapshots are existing project text; source assessments are minimal original notes, not copied definitions or corpus extraction.
Support additions are proposals for parent review. Partial senses intentionally remain unscoped at whole-record level; notes identify exact supported concepts.

British English can be a page section title rather than an exclusivity label. Explicit British AND Australian wording is retained where found, while no absent label is inferred. Literary historical witnesses do not establish current frequency.

Read source_policy.yaml: reference-only publishers manually verified; no scraper, copied definitions or dictionary corpus retained. A failed exact source is not proof the term lacks other evidence. Construction-unconfirmed rows are audit deferrals, not automatic recommendations to gate/delete valid vocabulary.
